name: Replicate - H100 GPU instance
price_basis: per H100 GPU-hour, on-demand, including 13 vCPU + 144 GB RAM. Fetched 2026-10-04. Per-second billing at $0.001525/sec. Single-GPU tier available without committed spend.
notes: Replicate H100 at $5.49/hr is priced at a premium to raw cloud providers, reflecting the model hosting and API layer. It is 22% below CoreWeave on-demand ($6.16) but 38% above Together AI's on-demand ($3.99) and 200% above Beam's on-demand H100 ($1.83). The per-second billing is advantageous for short inference jobs. Multi-GPU tiers (2x, 4x, 8x) require committed spend contracts. Replicate is a model hosting platform, not a raw IaaS provider.
